Is it really free?
Yes. Playing is free and there is nothing to buy on the site. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter. You open a game and play.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. All of the roughly 12,381 games run in your browser and start instantly, with no download and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Often, yes. Many games are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category. Games built for a wide screen ask you to turn the phone sideways, and a few older games need a keyboard and mouse and say so on their page.
Are the games safe for children?
We only list family-friendly games, with no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Recently played games, favourites and your light or dark choice are kept in your own browser and never leave your device. Most games also save their own progress the same way. The catch is that clearing your browser data or using private mode will erase them.
What are the cookie settings about?
Visitors in Europe are asked before non-essential cookies are used. You can change your choice at any time with "Cookie settings" in the footer.
Where do the games come from?

Six games are made by Door 404, the studio behind the site. Others are licensed from the networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, and 24 were sent in directly by independent developers. We never copy games from other portals.
How can I submit my own game?

Send it at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. It is free and non-exclusive, and a real person plays every submission. An accepted game gets its own page that credits you and links back to you, while the game stays hosted on your own server.
How do I get my game removed?
Email contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will remove it. You can ask for this at any time.
Can I embed a game on my own website?
Only our own games, which have an "Embed this game" box with ready-made code on their page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so we cannot offer embed code for them.
How do I reach a real person?
Email contact@ilovewebgames.com. The site is run by Door 404, an escape room and game studio from Novi Sad, Serbia.
